description.en:
The ID of the instance.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region, including instance IDs.

description.zh: 执行计划具体信息，JSON格式，内容需根据**PlanType**参数和**PlanScheduleType**参数的值进行调整，具体说明请参见以下补充说明。
description.en: The execution information of the plan. Specify the parameter in the JSON format. The parameter value varies based on the values of **PlanType** and **PlanScheduleType**. The following section describes the PlanConfig parameter.

description.zh: 计划的结束时间，需要大于查询开始时间，格式为yyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 > - 仅**周期执行**的计划需要设置该参数。 >- 该参数非必填，没有结束时间，计划删除周期停止。
description.en:
The end time of the plan. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC. The end time must be later than the start time.

> 

*   This parameter must be specified only for **periodically executed** plans.

*   If you do not specify this parameter, the plan stops until the plan is deleted.

description.zh:
计划ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstancePlans](~~449398~~)接口查看计划的详细信息，包括计划ID。
description.en:
The ID of the plan.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBInstancePlans](~~449398~~) operation to query the details of plans, including plan IDs.

description.zh: 计划的开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 > - 仅**周期执行**的计划需要设置该参数。 >- 不传默认为当前时间。
description.en:
The start time of the plan. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

> 

*   This parameter must be specified only for **periodically executed** plans.

*   If you do not specify this parameter, the current time is used.

descriptions.en:
You can call this operation to modify a plan for an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance in Serverless mode. For example, you can modify a plan for periodically pausing and resuming an instance or scaling an instance.

## Limits

You can call this operation up to 1,000 times per second per account. If the number of the calls per second exceeds the limit, throttling is triggered. As a result, your business may be affected. We recommend that you take note of the limit when you call this operation.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb update-db-instance-plan --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --plan-name test-plan --plan-desc this_is_a_test_plan --plan-start-date 2022-04-17T23:00Z --plan-end-date 2023-04-17T23:00Z --plan-config pause_:_executeTime_:_2022-08-30T16:00:00Z --plan-id 1234 --region cn-hangzhou
